```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("R/helper.R")

species = '9606'
# species_id = c(human = "9606", mouse = "10090", rat = "10116")[species]

links = paste0("https://stringdb-downloads.org/download/protein.links.v12.5/", species, ".protein.links.v12.5.txt.gz")
info = paste0("https://stringdb-downloads.org/download/protein.info.v12.5/", species, ".protein.info.v12.5.txt.gz")
  
names <- read_tsv(info) %>%
    select(1:2)
interactions <- read_delim(links, delim = " ")

# run this only if high reliability needed
full = "https://stringdb-downloads.org/download/protein.links.full.v12.5/9606.protein.links.full.v12.5.txt.gz"
fullint <- read_delim(full, delim = " ")

net_filt <- generate_string_ppi(links, info, fullint, 
                                           best_evidence = c('experiments', 'textmining', 'database', 'coexpression'), 
                                           transferred = F, genomic = F, to_kinograte = T )


write_csv(net_filt, "ppi_network_human_filtered_v12.5.csv")
write_delim(net_filt, "ppi_network_human_filtered_v12.5.txt", delim = "\t")
save(net_filt, file = "ppi_network_human_filtered_v12.5.rda")


```
